requirement: The system shall allow new resident trainees to register with an email address, password (minimum 8 characters), and full name.
The system shall reject duplicate registration attempts with existing email addresses returning HTTP 409 and a localized error message.
The system shall authenticate users using bcrypt password verification and issue an HTTP-only, SameSite-strict `rt_session` JWT cookie.
The system shall enforce rate limiting on authentication routes (maximum 10 failed login attempts per 15-minute window per IP) returning HTTP 429.
The system shall provide a logout endpoint that invalidates and clears the client's `rt_session` cookie.
The system shall expose an identity introspection route (`GET /api/me`) returning the authenticated user's profile and active role.
The system shall enforce role-based access control guards prohibiting residents from accessing instructor routes (`HTTP 403`) and instructors from taking tests (`HTTP 403`).
The system shall isolate multi-tenant resident resources, strictly denying access when a resident requests another resident's sessions or images (`HTTP 404`).

The system shall initialize a resident's first test as a balanced baseline exam of 60 questions by default (configurable, min 45), consisting of equal class representation (20 each of `covid19`, `pneumonia`, and `normal` at default $N=60$; 15 each at $N=45$).

The system shall distribute baseline questions within each class across difficulty buckets according to a 40% Easy, 30% Medium, and 30% Hard quota (at default $N=60$: 8 Easy, 6 Medium, 6 Hard per class; at $N=45$: 6 Easy, 5 Medium, 4 Hard per class, or closest integer apportionment).
The system shall serve exam questions sequentially or by question index without disclosing ground truth pathology, difficulty score, or source dataset.
The system shall accept single-choice diagnostic answers (`covid19`, `pneumonia`, `normal`) and immediately persist progress to MongoDB.
The system shall provide keyboard navigation shortcuts (keys `1`, `2`, `3` for disease classes; `Space` for save & next) in the quiz interface.
The system shall maintain test state across browser reloads and navigation interruptions, resuming the active test without regenerating questions.
The system shall process answer submissions idempotently, preventing duplicate response records or altered answers for already-answered questions.
The system shall reject answer submissions or modifications on finalized tests returning HTTP 409.
The engine shall compute per-class False Positive Rate ($FPR_c$) and False Negative Rate ($FNR_c$) from cumulative confusion matrices using Laplace smoothing ($\alpha = 1$).
The engine shall calculate unweighted diagnostic error ($Error_c = FPR_c + FNR_c$) and normalize into error weights ($Weight_c = Error_c / \sum Error$) summing to 1.0.

The engine shall allocate test questions (default 60, configurable with floor $N \ge 45$) across classes using the largest-remainder method while enforcing a minimum floor of 20% of $N$ ($\ge 12$ questions at $N=60$; $\ge 9$ questions at $N=45$) per class.
The engine shall allocate questions within each class across difficulty buckets enforcing a minimum floor of 4% of $N$ ($\ge 2$ questions) per bucket.
The engine shall apply nearest-bucket fallback reallocation when the requested candidate image pool in a specific class-bucket combination is insufficient.
The system shall block creation of adaptive training sessions until the resident has completed the baseline examination.
The system shall track image exposure history, selecting candidate radiographs without replacement until the entire catalog pool is exhausted.
The engine shall provide a virtual resident simulator to benchmark adaptive versus random learning trajectories across configurable seeds and learning rates.
The system shall finalize an active test upon submission of all test answers (default 60, min 45), transitioning status to `finished` and computing summary statistics.
The system shall compute overall accuracy, per-class sensitivity (recall), specificity, precision, and F1-score for each finished session.
The system shall display a full $3 \times 3$ diagnostic confusion matrix showing the distribution of true versus predicted classes.
The system shall provide an item-by-item question review interface displaying the radiograph, user response, true diagnosis, and difficulty bucket.
The system shall display the computed adaptive error weights and projected question allocation for the resident's upcoming session.
The system shall allow residents to request pedagogical error explanations for mistake confusion pairs within the review interface.
The system shall support on-demand generation of a structured narrative performance report summarizing strengths and focal diagnostic weaknesses.
The system shall identify a resident trainee's top confusion pairs ($(c_{\text{true}}, c_{\text{pred}})$) from finished diagnostic session data.
The system shall generate 5-question micro-practice sets targeted to a selected confusion pair using instructor-approved question bank items.
The system shall deliver practice questions with 4 localized options without disclosing correct answers or rationale prior to submission.
The system shall display immediate pedagogical explanations and highlight the correct option upon practice answer submission.
The system shall serve practice questions entirely without live LLM calls, drawing exclusively from local approved MongoDB question collections.
The system shall enforce resident ownership and access isolation on practice sets, returning HTTP 404 for foreign sets and HTTP 403 for instructors.
The system shall maintain a longitudinal record of all finished training sessions for each resident, recording chronological accuracy trends.
The system shall evaluate class mastery status against an 80% cumulative accuracy benchmark for each pathology class (`covid19`, `pneumonia`, `normal`).
The system shall render longitudinal line charts plotting per-class accuracy across sequential sessions with high-contrast, accessible styling.
The system shall display prominent mastery status badges indicating achieved, in-progress, or deficient competencies per class.
The system shall provide an idempotent synthetic demo seed script (`npm run demo:seed`) generating pre-populated resident training histories.
The system shall provide a dedicated educational reference page detailing primary pulmonary findings (consolidation, GGO, pleural thickening).
The system shall provide disease summaries detailing characteristic radiographic presentations of COVID-19, non-COVID pneumonia, and normal anatomy.
The system shall display verified sample chest radiographs illustrating typical presentations for each pathology class.
The system shall display a persistent non-clinical disclaimer in the UI layout footer emphasizing educational use and prohibiting diagnostic triage.
The system shall provide an instructor roster view listing all registered residents with completed session counts, current mastery status, and aggregate accuracy.
The system shall enable instructors to inspect longitudinal diagnostic trajectories and error patterns for any individual resident.
The system shall permit instructors to audit detailed session reports and individual question responses for any completed resident test.
The system shall provide a dedicated question review queue enabling instructors to approve, reject (with reason), or edit AI-generated multiple-choice questions.
The system shall provide keyboard shortcuts (keys `A` for approve, `R` for reject, `J`/`K` for question navigation) in the instructor review panel.
The system shall guarantee that unapproved or rejected questions remain strictly inaccessible to residents and excluded from targeted practice sets.
The system shall provide an image catalog inspection interface displaying class counts, difficulty distributions, and demographic cohort confounder disclosures.
The system shall expose an administrative monitoring endpoint reporting LLM service health, daily quota consumption, and cache collection sizes.
The system shall extract standardized radiological findings from radiographs using Gemini models with a strict closed vocabulary (laterality, zones, pattern, distribution).
The system shall execute dual-prompt analysis validation and consistency checks before storing candidate image analyses in the database.
The system shall generate 4-option multiple-choice questions in Persian across three pedagogical types (`finding`, `distribution`, `differential`) initialized in `pending_review` state.
The system shall generate mistake-specific pedagogical explanations grounded in curated knowledge-base reference documents (`apps/api/src/modules/llm/kb/`).
The system shall synthesize session narrative performance summaries from engine-computed statistics without permitting the LLM to invent scores or ground-truth labels.
The system shall enforce a daily budget limit (16 requests per Pacific day) and 13-second inter-request throttling to protect free-tier API quotas.
The system shall support a fully network-isolated `cache-only` operational mode serving feedback exclusively from local MongoDB collections with zero outbound network traffic.
The system shall generate opaque HMAC-SHA256 tokens for public image referencing, preventing client exposure of catalog IDs, dataset origins, or filenames.
The system shall authorize radiograph image streaming (`GET /api/images/:publicId/file`), restricting residents to images included in their active or finished training sets.
The system shall provide an idempotent catalog seed script (`npm run seed:catalog`) that imports the curated 1,177-image catalog with difficulty metrics and pool-health checks.
The system shall provide export and import scripts for verified image analyses, approved questions, and portable LLM cache entries to support zero-network deployments.
Passwords shall be hashed using bcrypt with a work factor of $\ge 10$ rounds; plaintext passwords and `passwordHash` fields shall never be returned in API responses.
Authentication tokens shall be stored in HTTP-only, SameSite-strict cookies; the `Secure` flag shall be enforced when `NODE_ENV=production`.
The API shall set secure HTTP response headers via Helmet, disabling `X-Powered-By` and enforcing strict MIME-type sniffing prevention.
The API shall reject non-JSON state-changing request bodies with HTTP 415 and restrict incoming JSON payloads to a maximum of 100 kilobytes.
The system shall enforce rate limiting on sensitive routes, restricting login attempts to 10 per 15 minutes per IP and report narratives to 10 per 15 minutes.
Active quiz and practice question responses shall never contain diagnostic ground truth (`trueClass`), model confidences, difficulty scores, or dataset provenance.
Image file URLs and references delivered to clients shall use HMAC-SHA256 derived opaque tokens, completely concealing internal database IDs and filenames.
The system shall maintain zero patient health information (PHI), using only de-identified, publicly licensed academic research datasets.
The user interface shall provide native right-to-left (RTL) layout using Persian Vazirmatn typography and logical CSS alignment utilities.
All user-visible text, interactive controls, and notification badges shall satisfy WCAG AA contrast standards ($\ge 4.5:1$ normal text; $\ge 3:1$ large text).
Key user interface screens shall achieve Google Lighthouse accessibility scores of $\ge 95/100$.
All 19 application screens shall remain fully functional and responsive across desktop and mobile viewports (1366x768, 1920x1080, 390x844).
The web application shall provide 100% string localization coverage with zero hard-coded user-facing strings and complete English/Persian key parity.
The entire system shall execute natively on Microsoft Windows 11 workstations using Windows PowerShell 5.1 and modern PowerShell 7.
The platform shall operate without containerization engines (Docker), running against a local native Windows MongoDB 8.0 instance.
All npm lifecycle scripts and build commands shall be cross-platform, using Node.js utilities instead of Unix-specific shell builtins.
The platform shall maintain 100% functionality for all trainee test sessions and targeted practice without external internet or VPN access in `cache-only` mode.
The adaptive allocation algorithms and virtual resident simulation shall be strictly deterministic and reproducible given an identical random seed.
The system shall gracefully handle database disconnections and API outages, displaying user-friendly error banners with retry mechanisms.
The application code shall be written exclusively in standard JavaScript (ES Modules), with static type definitions documented via JSDoc `@typedef`.
All runtime data crossing architectural boundaries (HTTP requests, environment variables, seed files) shall be strictly validated using Zod schemas.
Monorepo codebases shall pass ESLint and Prettier style checks cleanly with zero unaddressed warnings or linting errors.
Monorepo automated test suites shall maintain comprehensive regression coverage across contracts, engine, backend API, and web components.
Fresh clone automated setup (`npm ci`, seeding, building) shall complete in under 30 seconds on a standard developer workstation.
REST API response times for standard non-LLM transactional operations (question delivery, answer submission) shall be sub-second.
Production frontend JavaScript vendor bundle size shall remain under 1 megabyte uncompressed.
